story.title: Indian Navy Gets 7th Homegrown Stealth Warship
story.sourceContext: 27 November 2026 official delivery announcement and GRSE design deep displacement, corroborated by Janes full-load displacement
story.claimStage: seven frigates delivered; final delivery not commissioning

scenes.headline:
Seven warships.
All delivered.
scenes.narration: The Indian Navy has received Vindhyagiri, completing the delivery of all seven homegrown stealth frigates under Project Seventeen A.

scenes.headline:
Built on
a massive scale.
scenes.narration: Designed by the Indian Navy, these advanced stealth warships are a hundred and forty-nine metres long and weigh nearly six thousand seven hundred tonnes when fully loaded.

scenes.headline:
Built across
two cities.
scenes.narration: Four were built at Mazagon Dock in Mumbai, and three at Garden Reach Shipbuilders in Kolkata.

scenes.headline:
Building
warships faster.
scenes.narration: All seven were delivered over a span of about twenty-three months. The final ship took sixty-eight months to build, sixteen months less than the first.

scenes.headline:
Powered by
Indian industry.
scenes.narration: The programme achieved seventy-five percent indigenous content, involving more than two hundred micro, small and medium enterprises across India.

scenes.headline:
Designed here.
Built here.
scenes.narration: From design to construction, the programme marks a major milestone in India's ability to build advanced warships at home.

story.youtubeTitle: Indian Navy Gets 7th Homegrown Stealth Warship
